name: Scientific library questions v1 — annotation in progress
note: The 35 development questions and 15 heldout-labelled questions are fixed, but the latter were exposed during candidate preparation and an initial baseline. They form a locked non-blind evaluation split, not a final blind test. Candidate packets and assistant adjudication are not human-reviewed gold judgments.
